title: Senior lead action triage — end of day
content:
Quick end-of-day triage for Wednesday — short, messy, actionable.

Context: heavy infra rollout week. Need to keep reactive items small and move blockers to owners for tomorrow. Focus on 3 outcomes I can influence + a short meeting prep list.

Top-3 outcomes for tomorrow (03/14)
1) Lock rollout config for Dedicated: agree on fallback policy and finalize autoscale thresholds. (Owner: Linh)
   - Risk: current thresholds cause oscillation at peak.
   - Ask: Linh to send updated sim numbers by 9am.
2) Resolve token-cost regression on v2 model routing rule. (Owner: Samir)
   - Blocker: discrepancy in quantized variant metrics (INF-8423).
   - Quick step: roll back routing rule to baseline at 10:30 if not resolved.
3) Customer touchpoint prep: Redwood Corp onboarding — confirm SSO + IP allowlist details. (Owner: Chris)
   - Deliverable: send short checklist and request for contact person.

Micro-agenda for tomorrow morning (30 min blocks)
- 08:30 sync with Linh: rollout thresholds + autoscale policy (go/no-go decision)
- 09:15 quick PR review (infra): GH/1198 — focus on config validation tests
- 10:00 customer onboarding call prep: confirm Chris has SSO doc and expected timeline
- 11:00 leadership stand: highlight fallback plan and cost regression mitigation

Follow-ups and actionable notes (triage buckets)
- Urgent / do today:
  * Samir: prioritize INF-8423 diagnostics, post thread in #infra-alerts with findings by 09:00.
  * Linh: small change to autoscaler policy, include hysteresis and min-cooldown. Put patch in GH/1198.
- Important / do tomorrow:
  * Ops: run cost-sim with 2x peak and attach CSV to JIRA.
  * Product: validate customer acceptance criteria for Dedicated SLA doc.
- Low / backlog:
  * Add rollout postmortem template to Confluence (target next week).

Meeting prep bullets (soundbites + asks)
- Exec sync (11:00): 1 slide headline — "Rollback guard engaged if regression persists; finalizing fallback config"; ask: executive sign-off on go/no-go window.
- Customer kickoff: Confirm SSO flow + required IP ranges; propose tentative launch date and note any vendor dependencies.
- Infra deep-dive (ad-hoc): request Samir to show quantization metric diff and candidate rollback plan.

Quick wins (doable in <30m)
- Ping legal for redwood-corp NDA status (Chris).
- Move 2 low-priority alerts to maintenance schedule.
- Approve small PR to add telemetry tags: GH/infra-telemetry/patch-7.

Blockers / outstanding questions
- How much headroom in Dedicated budget if we increase min instance count during rollout? (Finance check)
- Who owns the final acceptance test for SSO? Need single owner.
- Is there a known race condition in the rollout orchestration causing double deploys? (Ops to confirm)

Next-day planning (things to carry forward)
- If rollback occurs, run short post-rollback customer notification template.
- Prepare 2-minute summary for Friday all-hands on lessons learned.

Notes to self (unfiltered)
- Keep communication tight to avoid panic cycles.
- Be aggressive on canary hold: better slow + stable than fast + noisy.
- Remind Samir: triage threads should include "impact" and "expected fix ETA" in subject.

Todo checklist (tick when done)
- [ ] Confirm Linh's policy patch merged
- [ ] Samir posts INF-8423 findings
- [ ] Send Redwood Corp onboarding checklist
- [ ] Approve GH/1198 test additions

Slack refs / quick links
- #infra-alerts thread (pin)
- PM convo: slack.com/team/PMs#deployment-discuss

End — off to reset inbox for 30m then review morning threads.

——
Metadata: rough daily scratchpad. Not polished. Keep as single source-of-truth for my EOD action triage.
